name: CO2 methanation

sources.plant: 2-5 adiabatic stages with intercooling, 200-550 C, 20 bar reference case; >= 98 % CO2 conversion needs <300 C at 20 bar in the last stage (Goetz et al., Renew. Energy 85 (2016) 1371)
sources.capex: 175 EUR/kW_SNG (Goetz 2016, consistent with Outotec; range 130 EUR/kW at 110 MW to 400 EUR/kW at 5 MW) x 1.33 USD/EUR (2014) x 96.4 MW_SNG (50 kt/y CH4 at 8000 h, HHV)
sources.reference r: GHSV 3500 h-1 inside the 2000-5000 h-1 of technical adiabatic fixed beds (Goetz Table 4), 20 % CO2 in the feed, bed density 1.0 kg/L (assumption), X 0.80 -> 0.40 kg CH4/kg/h
sources.h2_usd_kg: 3 USD/kg: the anchor of Becker, Penev & Braun, J. Energy Resour. Technol. 2019 (132 USD/MWh SNG); grey ~2, electrolytic 5-7 (DOE Liftoff 2024)
sources.co2_usd_t: 104 USD/t CO2 captured (Enterprise Products EPA application 2012) rounded to 100
sources.catalyst: Ni 20 wt%, base 20 USD/kg, life 4 y: assumptions (no open source found)
sources.thermo: standard formation data, dH298 -165.0 kJ/mol, dG298 -113.5 kJ/mol

common_notes: crf 0.0944 = 7 %/y over 20 y (Enterprise Products PDH, EPA GHG permit application 2012). gas 2.5 USD/GJ = 2.60 USD/MMBtu paid by the PetroLogistics Catofin plant (SEC 424B4, 2012); Henry Hub 2024 2.19 USD/MMBtu (EIA). fixed O&M 4 %/y of capex, power 0.08 USD/kWh, metal recovery 0.95 and financing 0.08/y: assumptions as in the NH3/methanol chains.
